hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+commit" || exit 0; git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q "^CHANGELOG\.md$" || { echo "Stage CHANGELOG.md (update ## [Unreleased]) before committing." >&2; exit 1; }'

bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); case "$BRANCH" in main|HEAD) exit 0;; esac; echo "$BRANCH" | grep -qE "^(feat|fix|refactor|chore|docs|test)/[0-9]+-[a-z0-9-]+$" || { echo "Branch \"$BRANCH\" must match (feat|fix|refactor|chore|docs|test)/NNN-slug" >&2; exit 1; }'
